mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, u.nickname, profile.media_url AS profile_image_url, m.title, m.introduction, m.mood, m.access_level, m.created_at, bgm.media_url AS bgm_url FROM minihompy m JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN media bgm ON bgm.media_id = m.media_id LEFT JOIN media profile ON profile.target_type = 'PROFILE' AND profile.target_id = m.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO minihompy (user_id, title, introduction, access_level, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{introduction}, #{accessLevel}, #{createdAt})
